```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r}
INPUT_FILE <- "Raw Data/january.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE <- "Cleaned Data/january_cleaned.csv"

df <- read.csv(
  INPUT_FILE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character"
)

cat("Original dataset\n")

cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(df), "\n")

cat("\nColumn names:\n")

print(names(df))

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")

print(head(df, 5))

cat("\nOriginal flight dates:\n")

print(head(df$FL_DATE, 10))

cat("\nData structure:\n")

str(df)
```

## 2. Remove Duplicates

```{r}
duplicate_count <- sum(duplicated(df))

df <- df[!duplicated(df), ]

cat("Duplicate rows removed:", duplicate_count, "\n")

cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 3. Convert Data Types

```{r}
cat("FL_DATE before conversion:\n")
print(head(df$FL_DATE, 5))

cat("\nData type before conversion:\n")
print(class(df$FL_DATE))


# Convert FL_DATE to Date format
df$FL_DATE <- as.Date(
  trimws(sub("\\s+.*$", "", df$FL_DATE)),
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)

if (any(is.na(df$FL_DATE))) {
  stop("Some flight dates could not be converted. Check the original date values.")
}


# Convert columns to numeric
numeric_columns <- c(
  "YEAR",
  "QUARTER",
  "MONTH",
  "DAY_OF_MONTH",
  "DAY_OF_WEEK",
  "OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID",
  "ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID",
  "DEST_AIRPORT_ID",
  "CRS_DEP_TIME",
  "CRS_ARR_TIME",
  "CRS_ELAPSED_TIME",
  "DISTANCE",
  "ARR_DELAY",
  "CANCELLED",
  "DIVERTED"
)

for (column in numeric_columns) {
  df[[column]] <- as.numeric(df[[column]])
}


cat("\nData types after conversion:\n")
str(df)


cat("\nConverted flight dates:\n")
print(head(df$FL_DATE, 5))

cat("\nData type after conversion:\n")
print(class(df$FL_DATE))
```

## 4. Check Date Range

```{r}
cat("Date range\n")

cat(
  "Earliest date:",
  format(min(df$FL_DATE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Latest date:",
  format(max(df$FL_DATE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nFlights by year:\n")

print(table(df$YEAR))

cat("\nFlights by month:\n")

print(table(df$MONTH))

if (any(df$YEAR != 2025)) {
  stop("The dataset contains dates outside 2025.")
}

if (any(df$MONTH != 1)) {
  stop("The dataset contains flights outside January.")
}
```

## 5. Filter Selected Origin Airports

```{r}
airports <- c("ATL", "ORD", "DFW", "DEN", "JFK")

df <- df[df$ORIGIN %in% airports, ]

cat("Selected origin airports:\n")

print(airports)

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")

print(table(df$ORIGIN))

cat("\nRows after airport filtering:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 6. Check Cancelled and Diverted Flights

```{r}
cancelled_count <- sum(df$CANCELLED == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

diverted_count <- sum(df$DIVERTED == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Cancelled flights:", cancelled_count, "\n")

cat("Diverted flights:", diverted_count, "\n")

cat("\nCancelled flights by origin:\n")

print(table(df$ORIGIN[df$CANCELLED == 1]))

cat("\nDiverted flights by origin:\n")

print(table(df$ORIGIN[df$DIVERTED == 1]))
```

## 7. Remove Cancelled and Diverted Flights

```{r}
df <- df[
  !is.na(df$CANCELLED) &
    !is.na(df$DIVERTED) &
    df$CANCELLED == 0 &
    df$DIVERTED == 0,
]

cat(
  "Rows after removing cancelled and diverted flights:",
  nrow(df),
  "\n"
)
```

## 8. Remove Missing Arrival Delay

```{r}
missing_arr_delay <- sum(is.na(df$ARR_DELAY))

df <- df[!is.na(df$ARR_DELAY), ]

cat("Missing arrival delays removed:", missing_arr_delay, "\n")

cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 9. Create Target Variables

```{r}
df$major_delay_30 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 30)

df$major_delay_60 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 60)

cat("Major delay >= 30 minutes:\n")

print(table(df$major_delay_30))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 60 minutes:\n")

print(table(df$major_delay_60))
```

## 10. Create Date Features

```{r}
df$month <- as.integer(format(df$FL_DATE, "%m"))

df$day_of_week <- as.integer(
  format(df$FL_DATE, "%u")
) - 1

df$day_of_month <- as.integer(
  format(df$FL_DATE, "%d")
)

cat("Date features created.\n")

print(
  head(df[, c(
    "FL_DATE",
    "month",
    "day_of_week",
    "day_of_month"
  )])
)
```

## 11. Create Scheduled Time Features

```{r}
hhmm_to_minutes <- function(value) {

  if (is.na(value)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value <- as.integer(value)

  if (value == 2400) {
    return(0)
  }

  hour <- value %/% 100
  minute <- value %% 100

  if (hour > 23 || minute > 59) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  return(hour * 60 + minute)
}

df$scheduled_departure_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_DEP_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_arrival_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_ARR_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_departure_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_departure_minutes / 60
)

df$scheduled_arrival_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_arrival_minutes / 60
)

cat("Scheduled time features created.\n")

print(
  head(df[, c(
    "CRS_DEP_TIME",
    "CRS_ARR_TIME",
    "scheduled_departure_minutes",
    "scheduled_arrival_minutes",
    "scheduled_departure_hour",
    "scheduled_arrival_hour"
  )])
)
```

## 12. Check Invalid Scheduled Times

```{r}
invalid_departure_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_departure_minutes)
)

invalid_arrival_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_arrival_minutes)
)

cat(
  "Invalid departure times:",
  invalid_departure_count,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Invalid arrival times:",
  invalid_arrival_count,
  "\n"
)
```

## 13. Check Missing Values

```{r}
missing_values <- colSums(is.na(df))

print(missing_values)

cat(
  "\nTotal missing values:",
  sum(missing_values),
  "\n"
)
```

## 14. Final Dataset Summary

```{r}
cat("Final dataset\n")

cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "\n")

cat("Columns:", ncol(df), "\n")

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")

print(table(df$ORIGIN))

cat("\nFlights by airline:\n")

print(table(df$OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER))

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")

print(head(df, 5))
```

## 15. Summary Statistics

```{r}
cat("Arrival delay statistics:\n")

print(summary(df$ARR_DELAY))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 30 minutes:\n")

print(table(df$major_delay_30))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 60 minutes:\n")

print(table(df$major_delay_60))

cat("\nDistance statistics:\n")

print(summary(df$DISTANCE))

cat("\nScheduled elapsed time statistics:\n")

print(summary(df$CRS_ELAPSED_TIME))
```

## 16. Save Cleaned Dataset

```{r}
if (!dir.exists("Cleaned Data")) {
  dir.create("Cleaned Data")
}

write.csv(
  df,
  OUTPUT_FILE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Preprocessing completed.\n")

cat("Output file:", OUTPUT_FILE, "\n")

cat("Final rows:", nrow(df), "\n")

cat("Final columns:", ncol(df), "\n")

cat("File saved successfully.\n")
```
